title: INTRODUCTION TO WOOD PRODUCTS MANUFACTURING
description: First of a three-term series exploring technologies and management practices associated with manufacturing products from wood and other renewable materials. Covers major processing steps for the conversion of raw materials into products. Emphasizes major processing steps, equipment, and the impact of material properties on processing strategies.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisite: WSE 210.
A minimum grade of C- is required in WSE 210.
